'''icebreath Harvest Mains''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[David Kangas|icebreath]]
* '''Published:''' 24 October 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Naboo: Boss Nass' Chambers|Theed-L-naboobossnassschambers.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Naboo: Boss Nass' Chambers
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 Naboo Boss Nass' Chambers icebrea.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

An EPP Mains deck with a bit of a twist.

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

What can I say?  It's a pile!

The strat is actually very simple.  Start play like a Mains & Toys deck gone mad by pulling Boss Nass and the Gungans to boost your activation at the Boss's Chambers, and use Tunnel Visions indiscriminately.  The idea here is to make your opponent grab a Tunnel... that way he isn't grabbing something important, like Harvest or Bad Feeling About This.  If he doesn't take the bait after the first 3-4 copies, you may have to start annoying him with OOC&TT;, Clash, and Strike Blocked... whatever you do, don't play any Harvest-related cards until they've grabbed something!

Your main target for the Tunnel Visions is to grab your Harvest set up.  You need the Lars' Farm, Owen & Beru, and Artoo & Threepio to set this up.  Your other targets for Tunnel are the three twixes (Home One War Room, Yoda's Hut, and Rendezvous Point) or whatever you may need at the time.

Once you have your Harvest cards and the opponent has grabbed something, drop the Lars' Farm, Owen & Beru, and Artoo & Threepio.  A&T; can grab a copy of Bad Feeling About This for attrition protection, and the Talz's provide forfeit fodder and weapons fodder.  Harvest away!

While that's going on, just use the EPP's to beat the crap out of your opponent, and do the occasional Jar Jar Bomb to mix things up a bit.  Pretty much everything else is meta-related, so it won't really be any use to explain it all here.

Enjoy!

David Kangas

Shadow 31

Ophidian Agent

Vancouver, WA
